ws_client — minimal synchronous WebSocket client (RFC 6455).

Uses std/net (OpenSSL, already a project dependency via ssl define). Designed for dedicated OS thread use — all operations are blocking. Implements text, ping/pong, and close frames.

Timeout model: recvFrame(ws, timeoutMs) raises TimeoutError if the first byte of a new frame does not arrive within timeoutMs. Subsequent bytes of the same frame are read without a timeout (data is already in flight).

Procs

proc recvFrame(ws: WsClient; timeoutMs = 1000): WsFrame {.
    ...raises: [TimeoutError, OSError, SslError, IOError],
    tags: [ReadIOEffect, TimeEffect], forbids: [].}
Receives one WebSocket frame (server → client, unmasked). Waits up to timeoutMs for the first byte; raises TimeoutError if none. Subsequent bytes of the same frame are read without timeout. Source   Edit   
proc sendFrame(ws: WsClient; data: string; opcode = WsOpcodeText) {.
    ...raises: [SslError, OSError], tags: [WriteIOEffect], forbids: [].}
Sends one masked WebSocket frame (client → server MUST be masked per RFC 6455). Source   Edit
